name: Henri Binsztok
description: Henri co-founded OKcontract Labs, that does frontier cybersecurity research for onchain systems, and whose work was focused by Vitalik. He is also a security badge holder for TheDAO and a partner at 50 Partners. Before that, he was the Chief Innovation Officer at Wallix (Bloomberg: ALLIX.PA), and received numerous awards in his career including the French Ministry of Research Innovation Prize. Henri holds a PhD in Machine Learning from Paris Sorbonne.
